additional_controls.method: Original concatenated SQL extracted from unchanged mvptable.cpp and executed in Python SQLite memory database; two explicitly labeled separator-only diagnostic adaptations. No C++ MVP or SQLiteCpp runtime.

conclusions: Both no-vantage-point selection SQL branches concatenate sum_distFROM without a separator and fail SQLite preparation. Separator-only adaptation repairs full-pair query; sampled branch still references p.id absent from sampled_points projection.
Inclusive distance comparison in str_ins_query and shell intersection boundaries read; no complete index recall or performance qualification.

Static dist_fn shared across MVPTable instances, initially empty vp_ids statement initialization, signed partition bit limits and transaction boundaries remain source-only concerns. Database wrapper adds an initial vantage point before normal insertion, so SQL branch failures are not claimed to affect every CLI insertion.
Prefix hash distance is not a metric on unrestricted mixed-length inputs; documented prefix matching is not itself a policy defect. Flat images share hashes; identity requires stronger evidence.

PNG successful return paths omit png_destroy_read_struct and png_read_end; end_info allocation check tests info_ptr instead. Source-only resource and validation observations; no decoder runtime control.
PNG alpha is composited against bKGD or black; 16-bit samples stripped to eight bits and gamma conversion commented out. JPEG requests RGB; no explicit EXIF orientation or ICC normalization observed.
CLI DCT parser uses stoi without validating consumed suffix; database distance/limit parsing uses unsigned conversions. No malformed-argument execution or destructive database operation performed.
Build workflow performs builds/package upload, has no test step, and testPresets is empty. One original PNG visually inspected: small beige/gray geometric silhouette.
